intelligence.essence: Every orb shows exactly one number — dynamic, beautiful, always there. No hover to reveal it. No flash. No second number competing with it. One number and its label, sitting in the orb like a real object.
intelligence.human_view:
Shawn tested the orbs and found two wrongs: a small static number you couldn't read, and a big number that only appeared on hover — flashing. Both wrong. He said it four times over ("I keep telling you the same thing over and over"), then locked the rule: one number, dynamic, displayed without hovering, without flashing, with a label saying what it is.

"The static one has to go. The flashing one needs to stay but needs not to flash." — then, sharper: "It must be there always, not just when I hover over it."

And the click contract, from the same session: "What should be there is a number that's dynamic, beautiful, and when I click on it, it should go into the stats page. There should not be two sets of numbers."
intelligence.simple_view: Every round orb on the dashboard shows one number, big and clear, all the time — you never have to touch it or wave at it to see the number, and it never blinks. Tap the orb and it opens the full story of that number.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, each little round dial shows you one number, plain as day, all the time — no squinting, no hovering your hand over it to make the number appear, and it doesn't flash at you. One number per dial, with a little label saying what it is.
intelligence.naya_view: I render exactly one number per orb: dynamic, labeled, always visible, never flashing, never hover-gated, and never duplicated by a second number set. The number is the door — a click goes to that orb's stats. On touch devices there is no hover, so hover-reveal is a broken promise by design.
intelligence.ai_view: The orb's number is the citizen's instant answer — "where am I?" in two seconds. If it hides behind a hover, it fails the phone-first law (no hover on touch). If it flashes, it feels broken. If two numbers fight, neither is trusted. One number, always on, is the difference between a dashboard and a decoration.

machine_view.title: One Number, Always Visible, Never Flashing
machine_view.machine_section: Contract per orb: displayed_numbers = 1 (dynamic value) + 1 label. States: always-visible; no hover-reveal; no flash animation. Interaction: click → stats page for that orb (SN-0864 level 2). Violation classes: static unreadable number, hover-only number, dual number sets.
